name: Knox County, MO
findings: Knox County has 26 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Knox County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
64% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Knox County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 73% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
